entities.name: Rafael Filiberto Bonnelly
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rafael Filiberto Bonnelly Fondeur was a Dominican politician, lawyer, scholar, diplomat who served as the 42nd president of the Dominican Republic from 1962 until 1963. Previously, he was the 25th vice president under President Joaquín Balaguer from 1960 to 1962.
